summary.text: A pair of demonic path rising stars named Fang Zheng and Bai Ning Bing when Gu Masters recognize them on the road to San Cha mountain.

claims.text: At the foot of San Cha mountain, watchers name the pair as one man and one woman: black cloth, black hair and black eyes beside white cloth, silver hair and blue eyes.

A rank three old demonic Gu Master, old monster Hei Shi, blocks Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing and demands primeval stones, stripped clothes, and three kowtows. Fang Yuan answers with a beast phantom that drops breath concealment Gu’s cover and shows rank four aura; Bai Ning Bing keeps Hei Shi from fleeing, and the phantom turns him into minced meat. Fang Yuan then kills a spectator, Jin Cheng En, and the watchers in the dark flee.

Closer to San Cha Mountain, the two keep breath concealment Gu up, hide rank four aura, and kill Gu Masters they meet so a vicious reputation runs ahead of them. Narration says months have passed since the three kings inheritance appeared there, and righteous and demonic path fight for entry quota while the mountain turns into a slaughterhouse. At the mountain foot, when a female Gu Master kneels and begs, Fang Yuan steps back, asks why he would save her, and tells the Ten Tyrants members behind him to continue and give him a good show.

A Ten Tyrants Gu Master thanks the two black and white twin demons for watching and says they will report that friendship to their boss. The female Gu Master then reveals rank four strength, floors the Ten Tyrants members, and tries to shame little beast king for leaving her in distress. Fang Yuan names her Hu Mei Er and says that level of acting cannot trick him. Watchers say she used the Ten Tyrants to probe and get close to the black and white demons, and that little beast king saw through the disguise.

In a cave on San Cha mountain, Ten Tyrants leader Tyrant Heng Mei hears that Hu Mei Er used his men to test the Black and White Demons and injured seventh and tenth brother. He forbids revenge on Hu Mei Er, then says the Ten Tyrants of Nan mountain will not take it lying down and will go find the black and white demons. He plans to visit personally, offer respect, and propose working together against Hu Mei Er so the young pair can be used as vanguard.

When Fang Yuan and Bai Ning Bing take a mid-mountain cave, Mang Kuang asks if they are the black and white twin demons, recalls they are rank four and kill without blinking, then flees after flattering them. Tyrant Heng Mei arrives outside to pay a visit, speaking loudly so nearby Gu Masters notice that even he came personally. Fang Yuan answers that he was about to visit, then challenges a life and death battle as a strength path Gu Master and attacks at once. Fang Yuan fights Tyrant Heng Mei while Bai Ning Bing suppresses the other Ten Tyrants members; Tyrant Heng Mei ends beaten to a pulp, and Bai Ning Bing kills those other members while locking him down.
